question: By which standard units may the prescribed measurement be determined?
premises: Measurement may follow the six-barley and related distinctions.
Measurement may alternatively use the maker's own finger unit.
inference: The measurement may be determined either by the six-barley standard or by the maker's own finger measure.
uncertainties: The full sequence implied by ṣaḍyavādi is not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: It may be measured by the six-barley standard and its divisions, or by the maker's own finger measure.
